points.speaker: Bruce Westerman
points.quote:
It is not enough to just mine here at home. Our country also needs 
mineral processing capabilities to secure our domestic mineral supply 
chain. Crucially, this bill extends FAST-41 eligibility to both mining 
and mineral processing projects. We must have a comprehensive mineral 
strategy that engages and bolsters the entire supply chain. Developing 
domestic processing capabilities encourages the onshoring of industrial 
sectors and strengthens domestic supply chains from mining to 
manufacturing.
points.summary: It is not enough to just mine here at home. Our country also needs mineral processing capabilities to secure our domestic mineral supply chain. Crucially, this bill extends FAST-41 eligibility to both mining and mineral processing projects. We must have a comprehensive mineral strategy that engages and bolsters the entire supply chain. Developing domestic processing capabilities encourages the onshoring of industrial sectors and strengthens domestic supply chains from mining to manufacturing.

points.speaker: Jared Huffman
points.quote:
It is our third day back from a 5-week recess. We have 15 days left 
here in Washington before the election. It should be a time that we are 
trying to get some real work done, but instead of doing that, instead 
of doing a single thing to help our constituents who are struggling 
under skyrocketing costs of groceries, gas, and electricity bills, 
Republicans are scraping the bottom of the barrel to come up with any 
bill that their chaotic Conference can find a way to pass, and one of 
the surest ways, it seems, is to find a way to do another favor for the 
President's friends and for foreign-owned mining conglomerates.
points.summary: instead of doing a single thing to help our constituents who are struggling under skyrocketing costs of groceries, gas, and electricity bills, Republicans are scraping the bottom of the barrel to come up with any bill that their chaotic Conference can find a way to pass, and one of the surest ways, it seems, is to find a way to do another favor for the President's friends and for foreign-owned mining conglomerates.

selection.speaker: Bruce Westerman
selection.quote:
On average, it takes 19 years to bring a new mine into operation in 
the United States. Permitting delays drive up costs, halt economic 
growth, stifle innovation, and increase our reliance on foreign 
adversaries.
selection.summary: On average, it takes 19 years to bring a new mine into operation in the United States. Permitting delays drive up costs, halt economic growth, stifle innovation, and increase our reliance on foreign adversaries.
selection.reason: Explains that delays hurt growth and increase dependence on adversaries, supporting streamlined permitting.

selection.speaker: Bruce Westerman
selection.quote:
Representative Shreve's legislation is an important step in 
strengthening domestic production, securing supply chains, and ensuring 
that America leads the way.
selection.summary: Representative Shreve's legislation is an important step in strengthening domestic production, securing supply chains, and ensuring that America leads the way.
selection.reason: Supports the bill as a way to strengthen domestic production and supply chains.

selection.speaker: Bruce Westerman
selection.quote:
Our need for critical minerals and mining spans administrations. We 
need certainty in the process so that we can access the supplies of ore 
that we have here in the United States to meet our own demands. If we 
start playing political permitting ping-pong from one administration to 
the next, that gives no certainty to investors in America to use our 
own materials. That is exactly why we need to codify this, so that it 
gives everybody a fair shot to use the process.
selection.summary: Our need for critical minerals and mining spans administrations. We need certainty in the process so that we can access the supplies of ore that we have here in the United States to meet our own demands. If we start playing political permitting ping-pong from one administration to the next, that gives no certainty to investors in America to use our own materials. That is exactly why we need to codify this, so that it gives everybody a fair shot to use the process.
selection.reason: Argues for codifying the policy to provide certainty and avoid shifting permitting rules.

selection.speaker: Bruce Westerman
selection.quote:
H.R. 1501 would also prohibit any future administration from 
finalizing or implementing the Biden-era proposed rule to narrow FAST-
41 coverage to only critical mineral mining projects. Narrowing FAST-41 
eligibility in this manner would further increase our country's 
dependence on foreign nations and adversaries for mineral production.
selection.summary: H.R. 1501 would also prohibit any future administration from finalizing or implementing the Biden-era proposed rule to narrow FAST- 41 coverage to only critical mineral mining projects. Narrowing FAST-41 eligibility in this manner would further increase our country's dependence on foreign nations and adversaries for mineral production.
selection.reason: Supports preventing narrower eligibility because it would increase dependence on foreign nations and adversaries.

selection.speaker: Bruce Westerman
selection.quote:
Mr. Speaker, if you support our domestic supply of critical minerals, 
this bill provides the regulatory certainty necessary to strengthen 
domestic mineral supply chains. If you support weakening China's global 
control over minerals, then I would say join us in voting for the 
Protecting Domestic Mining Act.
selection.summary: Mr. Speaker, if you support our domestic supply of critical minerals, this bill provides the regulatory certainty necessary to strengthen domestic mineral supply chains. If you support weakening China's global control over minerals, then I would say join us in voting for the Protecting Domestic Mining Act.
selection.reason: Frames the bill as providing certainty and weakening China's control over minerals.

selection.speaker: Adelita S. Grijalva
selection.quote:
At a time when we should be strengthening environmental protections, 
respecting Tribal sovereignty, and ensuring communities have a 
meaningful voice in decisions that affect their land and water, this 
bill moves us in the wrong direction.
selection.summary: At a time when we should be strengthening environmental protections, respecting Tribal sovereignty, and ensuring communities have a meaningful voice in decisions that affect their land and water, this bill moves us in the wrong direction.
selection.reason: Argues the bill weakens environmental protections and Tribal sovereignty while excluding affected communities.

selection.speaker: Jared Huffman
selection.quote:
Unfortunately, this administration seems to have a different 
approach. They are throwing billions of taxpayers' dollars at the 
projects that only seem to benefit themselves. There is a lot of money 
flying right now in the name of strengthening the mineral supply chain, 
but when you look beneath the surface, it is going to projects that 
will not actually help the American people.
selection.summary: They are throwing billions of taxpayers' dollars at the projects that only seem to benefit themselves.
selection.reason: Claims the administration is directing public money toward projects that benefit insiders instead of the American people.

selection.speaker: Val T. Hoyle
selection.quote:
This legislation does not make our supply chains more secure or even 
ensure that more of the domestic critical minerals that we need will 
get mined for American workers.
selection.summary: This legislation does not make our supply chains more secure or even ensure that more of the domestic critical minerals that we need will get mined for American workers.
selection.reason: Directly says the bill fails to improve supply chain security or increase domestic mineral production for American workers.

selection.speaker: Val T. Hoyle
selection.quote:
We do not need to be a cheap date for foreign entities so the 
President and his family and his donors can get rich off the companies 
that they are personally invested in. That is not in the best interests 
of Americans or American workers.
selection.summary: We do not need to be a cheap date for foreign entities so the President and his family and his donors can get rich off the companies that they are personally invested in.
selection.reason: Opposes the bill as enabling foreign entities and enriching the President, his family, and donors.

selection.speaker: Jared Huffman
selection.quote:
This does nothing to help lower prices for Americans. It just gives 
gold mines or even mines owned by our foreign adversaries the same 
access to FAST-41 streamlining as minerals projects needed for our 
national or economic security interests.
selection.summary: This does nothing to help lower prices for Americans. It just gives gold mines or even mines owned by our foreign adversaries the same access to FAST-41 streamlining as minerals projects needed for our national or economic security interests.
selection.reason: Says the bill fails to lower prices and wrongly treats nonessential or foreign-owned mines like strategically important projects.
